about: The term-recall fixture set for `dettivo-qa bench vocabulary` (ADR 0087). Each clip is one sentence synthesised by scripts/qa/make-vocabulary-fixture.py from `say` with a Piper voice; `text` is what was meant. Target clips carry a vocabulary term, distractor clips a sound-alike word that must not become one, guard clips general speech with no term.

voices.amy: Piper en_US-amy-low (rhasspy/piper-voices, dataset from MycroftAI/mimic3-voices; licence as stated there)
voices.ryan: Piper en_US-ryan-low (rhasspy/piper-voices, dataset RyanSpeech; CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)
